author: KenjiKido
body:
Nexus was always, always the game that I had loved with all of my heart. Now, I bet no has gone on there since the Omega update. And I am standing up for all the people who love Walls (people still play it, but barely any people.), CTH, and McZone. Now, you don't have to do anything, but if you could, I would be so proud of the Avicus developers. It might seem that I am a stupid and idiotic person with some of the reasons, but no guts, no glory.


  1. Shut down every single hub temporarily except Legacy. I know, that is so berserk and stupid. You might think that I am a psychopath,  but people are not even going to check out the Legacy servers. They are so attracted by all the other hub names. I am perfectly fine if you don't do this.
  2. Why did you even make Team Deathmatch? That is the same thing as Nexus, except the kits! Instead of Nexus being Team Deathmatch, add some other features to Nexus. I thought of one like putting multiple beacons on the map, and if you are the first person to get to it, it will give your team 5 kills. It could automatically reset every 2 minutes. And add more than 1 feature. In addition, add some features to walls and cth as well.
  3. Last time I checked, wasn't Mczone the same as destroy the monument? You don't need Mczone anymore.
  4. Another way to attract players is not to name it "Legacy". That doesn't grab a players attention. Instead, name it something that has the same interest rate as "AIDS AND CANCER HAVE BEEN CURED!!!!!1111!!!"
  5. Add a new, awesome, fun to play, eye-catching gamemode on Legacy and announce it loud and proud. This way, the people who go on the Legacy game will think, "What's CTH, Nexus, and Walls? Let me see if it is good!"
         Now, I am perfectly fine if you don't do any of this, as going to a good college and getting a good job is far more important to me. Really appreciate your time for reading this much! :)
